The '''Shataum Sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

[[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Shataum included [[Kroctar]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] world which joined the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] due to the manipulations of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra]], who presented the ruling government with a [[Flim (Human)|phony]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].<ref name="VotF" />
